batting.dismissal: c R Rampaul b RP Singh

batting.name: JP Faulkner
batting.dismissal: c R Rampaul b RP Singh

batting.name: SK Trivedi
batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b R Rampaul

batting.dismissal: c DH Yagnik b SR Watson

batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c A Chandila b SR Watson

balls.text: he was making room again, but this time he gets a short delivery to which he presents an sky-facing blade. The ball ramps off the face off the bat and settles in the hands of RP at third man
makes room and slashes this full delivery over cover, it goes high rather than long and drops just before the boundary. The fielder at deep cover pulls it in
moves his front leg out of the way and punches this length delivery past the non-striker for a single
again, moves away to the leg side and tries to slog a length delivery but misses, the ball goes past the leg stump
stays on the back foot to a short of length delivery and whips it away to deep backward square leg for a single
length delivery and the batsman comes forward and chips it over the bowler towards long on
he moves way outside leg stump, close to the wide marker and misses the full delivery, which misses the leg stump
he comes forward and presents solid front foot defence to a length delivery
another full delivery and the batsman was again moving away to the leg side, he jams it towards midwicket

the offstump is sent cartwheeling, but it was not such a great delivery, a mere high full-toss. Tait had moves outside leg and doesn't manage to get anything on it. Talk about hand-eye coordination, and that was a bad example
moves the front leg out and drives the ball over infield to the man at deep cover
short of length delivery, Tait plays it like a tail-ender by moving outside leg and throwing his bat at it, but he makes no connection
the procession continues. It's a good delivery by Vinay who fires it full and on middle stump. Sreesanth misses and it hits him right around his boot, plumb in front
short delivery outside off, the batsman lets it go through to the keeper

he bowls a full delivery on off stump, Chandila drives it to the left of ABdV at mid-off and sets off for a quick single. AB is quick too and he fires in a throw that hits the top of the stumps. Chandila was lucky to just have his bat over the line
length delivery on off stump, the batsman stays in the crease and defends it towards point

caught at mid-off! The wickets are falling very very quickly for Royals here and this innings is not going anywhere. Yagnik gets a full ball and he drives it straight to mid-off, who dives forwards and takes a good low catch
another short delivery and Chandila has no clue about that one. He fends at it and ends up gloving it, it lobs towards the empty gully area
short delivery on the body, the batsman plays a half pull, half steer to fine leg for a single
caught at long-on! he gets a full delivery and tries to launch it over long-on, but he doesn't get any the intended elevation in that, straight down the throat of the fielder down the ground
back of length delivery wide outside off, but Faulkner had come forward to it and the ball bounces over the outside edge as he tries to cut it
the batsman moves outside leg stump to a full delivery and cracks it straight to cover
he moves his front leg out, but gets cramped for room with a short of length delivery, drags it to deep midwicket
tries to smash it through off, but the bowler bowls it short and it bounces over the bat
length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and dabs it past backward point, but realises that Gayle is a bit slow to get to the ball after making a half-stop, they steal a couple
another short of length delivery for the new batsman, who sways out of line

the bowler corrects his mistake immediately by bowling it short of length just outside off. Hodge stays in the crease and tries to steer it to third man, but the ball bounces a touch extra and catches the outside edge en route to the keeper
that is some timing now from Hodge! It was a full delivery on off, but then he not only times it, he gives it a bit of whiplash punch to send it to extra cover
Yagnik is not wasting an times, he charges down the pitch and swipes the tossed up delivery wide of long-on
he tosses it up outside off and keeps the pace slow, the batsman tries to push it to the leg side, but gets an inside edge on to his pads

Dravid's scratchy stay in the middle comes to an end as he chips this full delivery straight down to long-on. He scored 35, but was struggling to get his timing going all through the innings. An important innings nonetheless
it's short of length on the middle stump and although Dravid doesn't get much timing with his pull, he hits it in the gap at deep midwicket
comes down the pitch to hit is over long-off, but it goes diametrically opposite to it off a thick inside edge
bowls it flat and short on off stump, the batsman stays on the back foot and punches it firmly to deep cover
tries to slog a length delivery to the leg side, but again, doesn't get any timing. It trickles towards midwicket but as the fielders are deep, they come back for a couple
gets a fuller delivery and he drives it powerfully down the ground, not much timing, but a lot of power in that. It splits the too fielders in the deep
that is an ugly attempt to pull by Dravid, but it was a slower delivery and he is beaten all ends up
he bowls a fuller length outside off and draws an outside edge as the batsman comes forward to drive, straight to third man
he makes room to this length ball and drives it on the up to wide long-off
length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it on the up to deep cover
slightly short of length , the batsman goes back and punches it to wide long-on for a single
another front-foot push, but again, it is straight to Kohli at cover
it's a tossed up delivery on off and the batsman comes forward and drives it straight to cover
now he comes forward and drives it down to long-on for a single
pushes it through on the middle and leg line, but Dravid is very quick to rock back and find enough power in his punch to beat the wide long-on easily
full and flighted on the leg stump, the batsman flicks it to deep square leg
takes a step down the pitch but the bowler bowls it slightly short. Hodge works it towards midwicket for a single
he gets a length delivery just outside off, but he doesn't get any timing with his cut shot, plays it straight to Gayle at point
he moves outside leg stump and crunches the length delivery to deep cover, just a single though
stays in the crease and opens the face to run it down to third man for a single
goes on the back foot to a length ball and defends it towards off
goes on the back foot and tries to chip it in the air towards wide long-on, but ends up playing it down the ground without much timing. It goes to the long-on fielder on the bounce
makes room by moving outside leg and mows this flat delivery to deep midwicket without any timing, settles for a single
slower, tossed up on off stump, but slightly short of length, allows the batsman to go back and punch it to deep cover
pushed through outside off, the batsman goes back and cuts it to point
pushed through on the pads, Dravid flicks it to deep midwicket for a single
he comes forward and pushes it down to long on
bowls a tossed up delivery at a very slow pace, the batsman has already planted his foot down and misses the ball, but it was going down leg
stays on the back foot and punches the back of length delivery to cover

this is a horrible shot by Binny after looking so good for the last 15 minutes. It was short and widish outside off, Binny decides to play another pull shot. But Vinay had cranked up the pace and the ball was getting bigger on him too, he just manages to get a big top-edge that goes behind the keeper, who takes a good catch running backwards
tries to upper cut a shortish delivery outside off, but the ball gets big on him and he is beaten
bowls a full delivery on off stump which the batsman drives to deep cover with ease
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman waits in the crease and opens the face to run it down to third man
oye! It was a short delivery on off stump and it looked like the batsman was beaten in his initial movement, but he smokes it over midwicket. It just bounces inside the boundary

tries to disturb the bowler with some movement in the crease and gets a full delivery on the pads which he murders with a powerful sweep over the deep backward square leg fielder. It went flat and into the crowd
moves outside leg stump, and the bowler bowls a quicker one angling it in, he can only jab it to short fine leg
stays on the back foot to a flatter delivery and chops it to point
he has timed it so well through the off side that the fielder at deep cover had no chance. It was a full delivery and he made some room and absolutely crashed it
bowls a flighted delivery on the middle stump, the batsman comes forward and pushes it down to wide long on for a single
here comes the slower delivery! The batsman dabs it towards point and calls for a quick single
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman stays in the crease and nudges it towards the right of midwicket for a single
finally Dravid gets hit timing right! It was slightly short of length on the off and middle stump and the batsman was quick to rock back and pull it past midwicket
another shortish delivery on off stump, he gets on top of the bounce and chops it towards gully for a single
gets a short ball as a response but Binny was ready for that, he waits on the back foot and ramps it to deep backward point for a couple
he cracks this length delivery through cover with some power! He made some room too as he played that one
short of length delivery outside off, he goes for a pull and doesn't get any timing again, straight to Kohli at midwicket
back of length delivery on off, Dravid opens his stance to push it towards mid-off, but is slightly early in his shot. He pushes it back to the bowler
classical cut shot this time as he gets some width outside off, but there is a deep point in place
length delivery  on the stumps, he stays on the crease and punches it down to long on
bowls a short delivery that comes a bit slow off the surface, it messes up with Dravid's attempted pull and he ends up dragging it to short fine
length delivery outside off, the batsman waits for it and then chops it down to third man
slower delivery on the stumps, the batsman is a bit early as he tries to whip it away to the leg side, ends up playing it towards square leg
back of length delivery on off stump, there is only a little room available and Binny gets on his  back foot and punches this one through the gap at cover point
he bowls it back of length on the off stump line, the batsman stands tall and punches it to cover
fuller length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and pushes it towards cover point

he has been done in by an excellent slower ball by Unadkat! Rahane sees length and comes forward to drive, but that was bowled at 118kph and he is too early into his shot, ends up slicing it towards point where Dilshan completes and easy catch
length delivery outside off which Dravid wrists towards square leg for a single

oh what a shot that is! He makes room and charges down at the same time, gets a shortish delivery that gets big on him, but he goes on with his punch shot over mid-off, and looks at the timing, it sails over the rope
length delivery on off stump, Dravid is struggling with his timing here and he pushes it towards the off side
he gets a length delivery outside off which he tries to smash back down the ground, but the bat face closes and the ball just eludes a diving mid-on, goes past his left to the boundary
back of length delivery and Dravid stands tall to play a back foot punch through off, but he is not able to beat the fielder at cover
short of length delivery outside off, Dravid makes room to hit it through off, but it bounces a touch extra and goes past the outside edge
length delivery on off stump, Dravid stays in the crease and punches it forcefully to the fielder at mid-off
he comes down the pitch and makes room at the same time, but the ball is delivered wide outside off and he only manages to get a toe-edge to it as he goes for a drive through off
he responds with a bouncer, and it is a quick one too. Rahane is beaten in his pull
walks a couple of steps down the pitch but gets squared up by a length delivery, plays it towards cover
that is a good hit! He gets some room just outside off and it's a length delivery. Since it's not swinging, Rahane just drives it over mid-on with a straight bat. One bounce and four
another length delivery on off stump, the batsman comes forward and pushes it past the non-striker. Mid-on and mid-off converge to cut the possibility of a single
length delivery outside off, Rahane leans forward and drives it, but finds the fielder at cover
slightly short in length, Dravid plays a pull shot straight to midwicket. He didn't get much timing on that as the ball came slightly slow off the deck
back of length delivery just outside off, Dravid stays in the crease and tries to punch it through cover, but the ball hits the inside half of the bat and heads back to the bowler
keeps it in the channel outside off with a length delivery, the batsman lets it go through
length delivery on middle and leg line, the batsman comes forward and defends to the leg side

caught at mid-off! It was another full length delivery on off stump and this time Watson goes straight with his shot, hits it really hard but doesn't get the elevation he would have liked. Murali Kartik times his jump to perfection and plucks it to give RCB the first boost
fuller length delivery on off stump, Watson drives it firmly with a slightly closed face, finds mid-on with that shot
no swing for RP, so he bowls it on a tight line around off stump. Rahane gets behind it solidly and defends to the leg side
similar line, but the length is a touch fuller. This time Rahane lets it go through
oh beautiful short this one! It was short of length delivery angling across him, he gets up with the ball and punches it through cover point
another back of length delivery on the stumps, Watson pushes it towards mid-on with soft hands and calls for a quick single. Kohli hits the stumps, but Watson dives in
keeps it tight around off stump with a short of length delivery, defended to cover again
bowls short of length on off stump, Watson stays in the crease and defends it solidly to the off side
another back of length delivery, just outside off, the batsman stays on the back foot and defends it to cover
back of length delivery on the stumps, Rahane stays in the crease and defends it solidly down the pitch
slightly short in length and that is enough for Watson to chop it past point firmly, the fielder there gets a finger to it to slow it down
beats the batsman with a length delivery outside off. Watson stayed in the crease and tried to dab it to third man
now he bowls length on the off and middle line, Watson gets solidly behind that and pushes it back to the bowler
bowls it short of length on the pads and all Watson has to do is flick it past the short fine leg fielder
all this while he was just playing with everyone's mind, because he can do it whenever he wants. Doesn't matter where the ball was pitched, the point is that it ended up over the sight screen
length delivery on off stump, the batsman steers it to third man and the scores are level
he walks down the pitch and flat-bats the short of length delivery with a powerful hoick to the deep midwicket boundary, then struts around with some swagger
length delivery outside off, the batsman punches it to mid-off
he bowls it short of length on the middle stump line and Tiwary shows some intent, he pulls it over midwicket in the gap
he comes down the pitch to a flighted delivery and powers it down to long-off
this time he comes forward to drive a fuller delivery, but inside edges it towards backward square leg
flatter delivery on the pads and this time Gayle paddles it without really bending his knees
slow loopy delivery outside leg stump, the batsman paddles it to fine leg for a single
flighted delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and defends it to the off
tossed up delivery on the stumps, the batsman goes back and turns it to square leg for a single
now he digs out a slower full delivery back to the bowler
he goes fuller in length this time, the batsman comes forward and drives it to mid-off
another short delivery ont he body, Gayle chooses to present a feather instead off a hammer, pushes it to square leg for a single
short of length delivery on the middle and leg line, Saurabh nudges it towards square leg for a single
another full and slow delivery on off stump, the batsman pushes it to extra cover for a single
bowls a full slower delivery on the pads, the batsman flicks it to deep square leg
another slow delivery outside off, the batsman pushes it to extra cover for a single
he comes down the pitch to this flatter delivery and muscles it down the ground. For a second the long-off fielder was interested but it sailed over him easily
comes down the pitch to a flighted delivery and drives it back to the bowler
flatter delivery on off stump, the batsman pushes it to cover off the back foot
tossed up delivery, very slow, Tiwary defends it off the back foot
he punches it hard to long-on and picks up an easy single
short of length slower ball outside off, the batsman punches it off the back foot to mid-off and takes a quick single
and another one of those, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to mid-off
the bowler is continuing with the slow stuff and the batsman are struggling to nudge them around
he bowls it on a length on leg and middle line, the batsman dabs it towards square leg for a single
short of length and a restrained Gayle pulls it along the ground to deep midwicket
he bowls a short of length slower delivery, but it's on the pads and Gayle works it to deep backward square leg
bowls a quicker delivery on off stump, the batsman punches it down to long-off
very slow tossed up delivery, the batsman comes forward to defend
tossed up delivery outside off, Gayle comes forward and defends
he waits on the back foot and turns this delivery towards square leg for a single
another one of those flatter deliveries, the batsman defends it towards the leg side
he pushes it through on the off stump, the batsman pushes it back to the bowler
he bowls a length delivery and the batsman comes forward to defend
he stays on the back foot and chops it to point, but Gayle is halfway down the pitch. A direct hit could have had him there
short delivery on the body, it is pulled to deep square leg for a single
slightly wide outside off, the batsman stays back and cuts it to deep point
bowls a slow offspinner on the pads, the batsman is not able to get bat on it, but he picks up a leg bye
he walks down the pitch but gets a short delivery, which he pulls to deep midwicket
and another full delivery on the pads, all Gayle had to do was help it on its way. No respite for Tait
back of length delivery outside off, it squares up the batsman as he steers it to third man
bowls a bad follow-up delivery after sharing words of wisdom, it's wide down the leg side
fuller length delivery on off which the batsman pushes back to the bowler. Tait gives him a few advices on life and cricket
he bowls it fuller outside off and Gayle plays an uppish drive over the infield, to deep cover
fuller length delivery honing in on the middle stump, the batsman digs it out towards cover
oh this is very similar to his last delivery, it was short of length and on the pads, it flicks the thigh pad and runs down fine
fuller length outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it to mid-off
he keeps getting decent bounce from just back of length, the batsman tries to work it to the leg side, but gets hit on the thigh pad
he stays on the back foot and chops the back of length delivery to point
another one with lack of pace outside off, the batsman punches it to cover off the back foot
bowls a short of length delivery outside off, the batsman pushes it to cover off the back foot
bowls it slower and on a back of length, the batsman drops it to the off side and calls for a quick single
oh that's a really poor start, another wide down the leg side
and he starts off with a short delivery down the leg side

oh that's a good catch at mid-off by Chandila! He didn't get the big wicket with the ball, but he takes an excellent low catch diving to his left at mid-off. AB charged down to a length delivery and absolutely smashed it as he went inside out, but he ends up playing it a lot straighter then he would have wanted. A second wicket for Watson
another full delivery outside off, AB drives it through the gap at extra cover without any fuss, no one moves
another fuller length delivery, this time on off stump, AB drives it to mid-off
he flicks a full delivery on the pads to deep square leg and calls for a quick couple as the fielder is a bit slow
he bowls a low full-toss on off stump, but AB drives it straight to cover
length delivery wide outside off, AB slashes at it without moving his feet and is beaten
he stays in the crease and punches the length delivery to the right of mid-off and calls for a quick single
back of length delivery on the stumps, AB defends it off the back foot

oh he has struck the big wicket! It was the back of the hand slower delivery to which Kohli comes forward to play, it was almost a left-hander's leg-cutter, and it does cut in to the batsman, takes the inside edge and hits the stumps
another short delivery on off stump, the batsman fends it off the right of point and takes a quick single
short of length delivery that is slightly slower in pace, Kohli runs it down to third man
bowls a short delivery from over the wicket, the batsman sways out of the way, but it is too high
length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and pushes it in the gap at cover for a single
pushes it a bit further on off stump, the batsman comes forward and drives it to cover
another short of length delivery on off stump, the batsman defends it solidly off the back foot

he gets a wicket in his first over this year! It was a short of length delivery outside off, Dilshan tries to push it towards off with an open face but gets a thick outside edge that the keeper takes low to his right
back of the length on off stump, the batsman goes back and pushes it to long-off
length delivery on off stump, 132 kph, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to cover
and his full delivery outside off is greeted with an inside out thump  over extra cover
length delivery, Dilshan comes forward and punches it to Dravid at cover
back of length delivery angling in to the batsman, the batsman defends it back to the bowler
bowls a good short delivery which climbs on to Gayle. The batsman fends it towards point and calls for a quick single
length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward to play it on the up, but he gets an outside edge to third man
back of length delivery that comes in to the batsman from wide of the crease, Dilshan pushes it to cover point
bowls a length delivery outside off, Dilshan comes forward and pushes it to cover
aimless he is, this Tait. This one is on the leg side and it catches the thigh pad on its way to the boundary
length delivery just outside off, Gayle arches back and punches it hard to the off side, but straight to extra cover
this is an example of what not to bowl when defending a small target. Tait attempts a short delivery, but his way down the leg side, the keeper gets a hand to it, but what's the point
bowls a high full-toss on off stump, the batsman pushes it to mid-on

oh Dilshan was quick to latch on that short delivery, it was 146 kph and coming on to his body, but he plays a inch-perfect pull, rolling his wrists on it as well, and sends it to deep square leg boundary
length delivery aimed at the off stump, the batsman wanted to punch it straight down the ground, but he gets and inside edge to square leg
he comes forward and drives a length delivery outside off to mid-off
short and wide delivery that comes slightly slow off the pitch, Dilshan cuts it hard but is not able to keep it down, it falls short of point, and beats him, goes hurtling towards the boundary
short delivery on the body, the batsman stands tall and works it to deep backward square leg for a single
full delivery on the pads, it is clipped to deep midwicket for a single
he attempts a slower delivery but this one is down the leg side, Dilshan just had to beat the fielder at short fine (Sreesanth) which he does and the ball races to the boundary
length delivery on off, the batsman comes forward and pushes it to the off side
bowls it full outside off and beats the bat as the ball tails away
another short delivery, Gayle has to hop on his toes as he defends it solidly back to the bowler
two slips are in place but he bowls it on the pads, turned away to fine leg for a single
short delivery on the body, Gayle stands tall and drops it towards midwicket for an easy single
how did that miss the stumps! 149 kph on a length just outside off, Gayle tries to push at it from the crease and it goes between the bat and the pad
bowls a short delivery, but this one is down the leg side. The keeper does well to dive to his right to catch that one
the bowler ramps up the pace with a length delivery widish outside off, it beats Gayle's flash

short of length delivery outside off, Gayle just stands tall and punches it through extra cover. It is not often you see fielder running in behind the ball after a Gayle shot, but Binny had a chance to stop that. A poor effort near the boundary gives the batsman four
he bowls length wide outside off, very wide, Gayle stretches for that but it's too far

too straight again, fuller length and on the middle stump, and when that doesn't swing, it's super easy for players of this calibre. Dilshan drives it past midwicket and the ball teases the fielder all the way to the boundary
errs in line and pays the price. Bowls the fuller length he has been bowling, but this one is on the pads and Dilshan flicks it with ease to deep backward square leg boundary
another fuller length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward to drives and pushes it to cover
that's a Sreesanth special and that beats Dilshan attempted off drive. It was full and it just seams away from the batsman very late
goes full on off stump, no swing this time, Dilshan punches it straight to mid-on
bowls a length and gets some inward swing into the left-hander, but it's on leg stump and the batsman nudges it towards square leg
pushed through on the middle stumps line, the batsman dabs it towards backward square leg for a single
flatter delivery, Gayle waits in the crease and punches it hard, straight to cover though
flighted and really really slow, the batsman punches it to cover point where Rahane makes a half-stop
doesn't toss it up, bowls it flat and Gayle pushes it back to him
another full and flighted delivery, driven to widish mid-off for a single
tosses it up and the batsman pushes it towards the non-striker where the bowler fields
